notes: 0018: prepares upcoming files while uploads continue, with two shared preparation operations and bounded speculative lookahead. Preparation never reserves uploads and known duplicates avoid thumbnail work. Monitoring uses watchdog filesystem notifications to update affected paths, with full reconciliation at startup, every five minutes, on topology/overflow and as a fallback. Files must remain unchanged for three seconds and have no active writer on Windows before preparation; mutations during hashing or before sending restart preparation. FFmpeg is cancellable and temporary thumbnails are unique. Observers and preparation jobs are cleaned up on stop. Premium routing, account selection, captions, required previews and deduplication policies are preserved. Includes lifecycle, mutation, native-watcher and concurrency regressions. The initial metadata observation covers the whole pending set, so fast small-file queues do not wait three seconds again for every lookahead window.
